implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in `src/num.js` — uses early returns to clamp n to the [min, max] range
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js` — scales the byte count and formats with one decimal place using B, KB, MB, GB thresholds
3. **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js` — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric-dash characters

All follow the project's code style: early returns, simple logic, no abbreviations beyond `n`.
